credit.credit-words: 2 There was an old skipper, I don'r know his name, Cho.
Altought he once played a remarkable game, Cho.
3 For his ship lay belcamed in the tropical seas, Cho.
And he whistled all day, but in vain for a breeze,* Cho.
4 But a seal heard his whistle and loudly did call,
"Roll up your white canvas, jib, spanker, and all." Cho.
During a calm, sailor whistle, believing a breeze will come in answer
Seals are said to be fond of music
